from agent import fs, shell, mutate

def Run(ctx, a):
    read = fs.read("index.html")
    html = read.text
    checks = {
        "single_html_file": True,
        "has_doctype": html.lstrip().startswith("<!DOCTYPE html>"),
        "has_add_form": 'id="add-form"' in html and 'type="submit"' in html,
        "has_complete_checkbox": 'type = "checkbox"' in html,
        "has_delete": 'del.textContent = "Delete"' in html,
        "has_localstorage": "localStorage.setItem" in html and "localStorage.getItem" in html,
        "has_no_external_assets": ("http://" not in html and "https://" not in html and "<script src" not in html),
        "lines": read.lines,
    }

    # Pull out the inline script and syntax-check it with node if available.
    script = html.split("<script>", 1)[1].split("</script>", 1)[0]
    node_check = {"available": False}
    try:
        v = shell.run(["node", "--version"], timeout=10000)
        node_check["available"] = v.exit == 0
        node_check["version"] = v.output.strip()
    except Exception as e:
        node_check["error"] = str(e)

    if node_check["available"]:
        # Write the JS inside the workspace under a temp name, then remove it.
        mutate.write(".tmp_check.js", script)
        r = shell.run(["node", "--check", ".tmp_check.js"], timeout=20000)
        node_check["exit"] = r.exit
        node_check["output"] = r.output.strip()
        shell.run(["rm", "-f", ".tmp_check.js"], timeout=5000)

    return {"checks": checks, "node": node_check, "size_bytes": len(html.encode("utf-8"))}

from agent import fs
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import re

VOID = {"area","base","br","col","embed","hr","img","input","link","meta","param","source","track","wbr"}

class Validator(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.stack = []
        self.errors = []
        self.ids = []
        self.tags = []
        self.scripts = []
        self.styles = 0
        self._in = None
        self._buf = []
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        self.tags.append(tag)
        d = dict(attrs)
        if "id" in d:
            self.ids.append(d["id"])
        if tag == "script":
            self._in = "script"; self._buf = []
            self.scripts.append(d)
        elif tag == "style":
            self.styles += 1
        if tag not in VOID:
            self.stack.append(tag)
    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):
        self.handle_starttag(tag, attrs)
        if tag not in VOID:
            self.handle_endtag(tag)
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in VOID:
            return
        if tag == "script" and self._in == "script":
            self.scripts[-1]["_body"] = "".join(self._buf)
            self._in = None
        if not self.stack:
            self.errors.append("unexpected closing </%s>" % tag)
            return
        if self.stack[-1] != tag:
            self.errors.append("mismatch: expected </%s>, got </%s>" % (self.stack[-1], tag))
            if tag in self.stack:
                while self.stack and self.stack[-1] != tag:
                    self.stack.pop()
                if self.stack:
                    self.stack.pop()
            return
        self.stack.pop()
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self._in == "script":
            self._buf.append(data)

def Run(ctx, a):
    r = fs.read("index.html")
    text = r.text

    v = Validator()
    v.feed(text)
    v.close()

    ids = v.ids
    used_ids = set(re.findall(r'getElementById\("([^"]+)"\)', text))
    attrs_for = set(re.findall(r'<label[^>]*\bfor="([^"]+)"', text))

    key_match = re.search(r'STORAGE_KEY\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', text)
    key = key_match.group(1) if key_match else None
    body = v.scripts[0].get("_body", "") if v.scripts else ""

    checks = {
        "doctype": text.lstrip().lower().startswith("<!doctype html>"),
        "tag_stack_balanced": not v.errors and not v.stack,
        "tag_errors": v.errors[:5],
        "single_script_inline": len(v.scripts) == 1 and "src" not in v.scripts[0],
        "single_style": v.styles == 1,
        "no_external_urls": not re.search(r'https?://|<script[^>]+src=|<link\b', text, re.I),
        "unique_ids": len(ids) == len(set(ids)),
        "ids_exist": used_ids <= set(ids),
        "label_target_exists": attrs_for <= set(ids),
        "storage_key_set": key == "todo-app.items.v1",
        "storage_get_set": "localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)" in text and "localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY" in text,
        "handles_add": 'form.addEventListener("submit"' in text and "items.push(" in text,
        "handles_complete": 'list.addEventListener("change"' in text and "item.done = checkbox.checked" in text,
        "handles_delete": 'data-action="delete"' in text and "items = items.filter(" in text,
        "renders_text_safely": "text.textContent = item.text" in text and "innerHTML" not in text,
        "has_accessible_labels": 'class="sr-only"' in text and "aria-label" in text,
        "script_balanced": body.count("{") == body.count("}") and body.count("(") == body.count(")"),
        "script_iife": body.strip().startswith("(() =>") and body.strip().endswith("})();"),
    }
    checks["all"] = all(bool(x) for k, x in checks.items() if k != "tag_errors")

    return {
        "path": r.path,
        "bytes": len(text.encode("utf-8")),
        "lines": r.lines,
        "truncated": r.truncated,
        "checks": checks,
        "ids": ids,
        "script_chars": len(body),
    }
